remarks: Enjoy the convenience of Stamford with this spacious one-bedroom condo-one of the largest in the well-managed Edgewater building-ideally located in a premium mid-city spot, just a short distance from downtown restaurants, shopping, the train station, major roads, and highways. This freshly painted second-floor unit offers an open floor plan featuring a generously sized bedroom, full bathroom, and a beautiful, spacious living room with a dining area and ample closet space. In addition to assigned parking spot #13 in the resident-only lot, street parking is available for guests. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included in the HOA. One cat or dog is allowed per unit. Laundry and storage are conveniently located on the main lobby level. You cannot go wrong with this unit!!
